purpose: If Gate007 shows value beyond exact RMS restoration, test whether that advantage is merely due to using an absmax dynamic scale rather than a stronger token-adaptive angular A4 scale chosen to minimize reconstruction MSE.
entry_condition: Gate007 must pass its robust exact-RMS-restored hostile-control rule on both WikiText-2 and C4. Otherwise do not run Gate008.

frozen_protocol.calibration_transfer: WikiText validation only; frozen unchanged for C4
frozen_protocol.data_construction: Identical to Gate007, including tensor hashes when available.

oracle_token_adaptive_angular_quantizer.input: u = h / RMS(h), followed by the same 64x64 block Hadamard transform used by the fixed-angular method
oracle_token_adaptive_angular_quantizer.selection: For each token independently, choose the candidate clip fraction that minimizes squared reconstruction error in the Hadamard-domain normalized direction. This may use the token values themselves but may not use labels, logits, downstream loss, or evaluation-corpus tuning.
oracle_token_adaptive_angular_quantizer.postprocess: Inverse Hadamard, reproject reconstructed direction to unit RMS, then multiply by the specified exact or 4-bit radial coordinate.
oracle_token_adaptive_angular_quantizer.interpretation: This is an intentionally overpowered quality oracle, not a practical rate-matched deployment baseline: it effectively spends extra runtime/metadata to choose a token-specific angular scale.

primary_rules.exact_fixed_grid_value: On each corpus, fixed_shared_angular_A4_exact_radius NLL < oracle_token_adaptive_MSE_angular_A4_exact_radius NLL and paired-bootstrap 95% upper CI of the per-sequence NLL difference is < 0.
primary_rules.practical_fixed_grid_value: On each corpus, fixed_shared_angular_A4_log4_radius NLL < oracle_token_adaptive_MSE_angular_A4_log4_radius NLL and paired-bootstrap 95% upper CI is < 0.
primary_rules.codec_fidelity: On each corpus, fixed_shared_angular_A4_log4_radius NLL <= fixed_shared_angular_A4_exact_radius NLL + 0.10.
primary_rules.robust_pass: All three rules pass on both corpora.

fallback_interpretation.oracle_wins: If the token-adaptive MSE angular oracle matches or beats the fixed/shared grid, narrow the mechanism: the earlier advantage was attributable to angular scale/clipping choice rather than fixed/shared angular coding per se.
fallback_interpretation.fixed_wins: If the fixed/shared grid beats this oracle on both corpora, the evidence for independently useful shared normalized angular structure becomes substantially stronger.

literature_boundary.BitNet_v2: Hadamard activation shaping for native A4 in 1-bit LLMs is prior art.
literature_boundary.LLM_FP4: Searching/optimizing quantizer clipping parameters to strengthen low-bit PTQ baselines is prior art; do not portray optimized clipping as novel.
literature_boundary.SmoothQuant_and_followups: Activation-range smoothing/scaling is established PTQ prior art.
literature_boundary.shape_gain: Magnitude-direction decomposition itself is prior art and not claimed as novel.

prohibitions: Do not tune candidate clip fractions after seeing Gate008 evaluation NLLs.
Do not use evaluation labels or downstream loss to select a token scale.
Do not call the oracle rate-matched to the 4.0015625-bit fixed/shared representation.
Do not reopen A3/A2/A1 regardless of Gate008 outcome.
